caption: The drawing depicts a single, clear glass tumbler centered on a plain, beige background. The glass is cylindrical, slightly tapering inward towards the base, and features several decorative patterns. Near the rim, there is a band with a wavy and jagged line design. Below this, a central section of the glass displays a diamond-shaped crosshatch pattern, followed by another band with diagonal lines. The lowest section has vertical etched lines near the base. The overall drawing is rendered in shades of black, gray, and white, using fine lines and shading to represent transparency, reflections, and intricate details of the glass surface. The name "RAYMOND NEUMANN" is printed in capital letters below the glass towards the bottom right.
title: Flip Glass
